title: Live Bytes Beat Every Claim, Including Your Own

intelligence.essence: Claims decay; only a fresh read of the live thing counts. Check the repair registry before calling a RED new. Endorse another lane's correction only on your own live re-read of the venue. Rebuild registries from live bytes — never triage a stale list. Classify before acting: genuine, false, or historical. When two lanes disagree about the outside world, re-measure right then and post the result. And when your own evidence disagrees with a gate, audit your instrument first — a truncated CSV once made the team call an honest check a liar.
intelligence.human_view: A quarantine list said 29 collisions were open. Rebuilt from live bytes, there were zero — 28 had already been healed before the list was even read. A sweep said 17 workers were still contaminating the checks; a live re-measure found zero — the director had already deleted them. A check said the database had orphan migrations; the CSV said zero orphans; the CSV was silently truncated at 100 rows and hid two orphans — the check had been right all along. The pattern in every case is the same: the claim was measured carefully once, and then the world moved. The discipline that replaces arguing from memory is a live-byte measurement in the current run, stated on the board, with custody kept explicit — what you verified yourself versus what you only witnessed. And when the registry and the published tree disagree on what a number names, the registry is the identity authority: the registered occupant keeps the number, the unregistered one is renamed by its owning lane — never deleted, never given a second entry.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine two friends arguing about whether it is raining. One remembers sunshine this morning; the other just came inside wet. You do not settle it by debating memories — you open the window and look. Right now. That is the whole rule: when people disagree about the world, look at the world, now, and say what you see.
intelligence.grandma_view: Yesterday's news is not today's truth. A list from yesterday can be wrong today, and your own careful notes can be wrong if you only read half the page. Before you act on a list, check the real thing with your own eyes. Before you blame the messenger, check your own measuring tape.
intelligence.ai_view: Never triage a list — triage the world. Enumerate from live bytes at pinned SHAs (main tree, open PR heads, date-partition scan, leading zeros normalized) before you classify, and classify by artifact type before you act: genuine (needs a disposition), false (by design — a pipeline twin, a tombstone), historical (already healed). A triage that ends with "nothing to renumber" is a completed triage, not a failed one, and renumbering is the disposition of last resort. When you endorse another lane's correction, re-read the venue's live state yourself — quoting their evidence adds no confirmation weight. When a gate's verdict contradicts your evidence, go to the source of truth directly; if both are exhausted and still disagree, record it plainly and park — "unverifiable from here" is a complete verdict, not a gap.
intelligence.what_it_means: A claim is a photograph of the world at one moment; the world keeps moving. The team that argues from photographs will fight ghosts — stale REDs, healed collisions, deleted workers — and will invent damage that no longer exists. The live read is the only measurement that can settle a disagreement, and the honest instrument check is the only thing that keeps the live read honest.
whats_inside: Never triage the list. Rebuild from live bytes, classify, then act — and check your own instrument before you call the gate a liar.
A claim is a photograph of the world at one moment; the world keeps moving.

Every false emergency in this family cost real work: a renumbering queue for collisions that no longer existed, a repair for a RED that already had one, a fight with a gate that was telling the truth.
When two seats disagree, you get a measurement, not an argument.
repair-registry check before any RED claim — open PRs plus board receipts for the exact class
re-read the venue's newest state immediately before posting
rebuild from pinned live bytes before triaging any list
classify GENUINE / FALSE / HISTORICAL before acting
endorse only on your own live re-read, with custody explicit — verified vs witnessed
audit your instrument's completeness — row limits, pagination, truncation — before calling a gate a liar
correct the record in the same venue with the same specificity when full data falsifies your verdict.
